profile_mapanything_memory_runtime: run the profiling script to measure GPU memory usage and inference speed of MapAnything across increasing view counts
profile_external_models_comparison: run the profiling script with external models like vggt pi3x must3r to compare memory and speed against MapAnything
profile_custom_view_counts: run the profiling script with custom view counts using the --num_views flag to test specific numbers of views
profile_mapanything_v1_comparison: run the profiling script with --profile_v1 to include MapAnything V1 models for comparison with the current version
profile_memory_efficient_mode: run the profiling script to test MapAnything in memory-efficient mode or skip it with --skip_mem_efficient
